name: Streaming An Ontology Driven Approach To Security Analysis Of Sui Move Smart Contracts 455Aa504F1
text: An ontology-driven approach to security analysis of Sui Move smart contracts states that attackers exploit smart-contract vulnerabilities to steal large sums and that defensive methodologies have developed in response. This independently corresponds to Kaal's identification of smart-contract vulnerabilities as a material loss channel. The abstract proposition does not verify Kaal's 2021 or cumulative dollar estimates, or establish a growth rate.
